title: Impact of COVID-19 Border Restrictions on Entry of Migrant Domestic Workers into Singapore
what_it_is: Impact of COVID-19 Border Restrictions on Entry of Migrant Domestic Workers into Singapore

sections.label: Tightened entry approvals for MDWs
sections.summary: From May, the Government tightened entry approvals for MDWs and other travellers from countries with higher COVID-19 incidence to manage importation and local transmission risk.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: From May, due to the resurgence of COVID-19 cases locally and globally, the Government tightened the entry approvals given to MDWs as well as other travellers from countries with higher incidence of COVID-19, so as to manage the risk of COVID-19 importation and local transmission.

sections.label: Postponed MDW entries rescheduled
sections.summary: MOM postponed about 1,800 approved MDWs' entry, rescheduled one-third so far, and hopes to schedule the remaining two-thirds by year-end.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM has also had to postpone the entry of about 1,800 MDWs who had previously received approval to enter Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Of those who had their dates postponed earlier, we have rescheduled one-third so far to enter Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Barring any further tightening of entry approvals by the Government, we hope to progressively schedule the entry of the remaining two-thirds by the end of the year.

sections.label: AEAS pilot and MDW entry priorities
sections.summary: AEAS began a pilot announced 14 July 2021; if successful, more MDWs may enter, though MOM will prioritise urgent care-giving needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The employment agency industry, through the Association of Employment Agencies Singapore (AEAS), has begun a pilot which we announced on 14 July 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: If the pilot proves successful in lowering the number of imported COVID-19-positive individuals, we can progressively allow for more MDWs to enter under this arrangement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Not every employer will be able to get entry approval for their MDW before the end of the year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: But MOM will continue to prioritise those with urgent care-giving needs.
